senses.zh_definition: Lefferts：用于人名及相关地名的姓氏；可音译为“莱弗茨”。具体所指须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A surname occurring in personal names and associated place names; its particular referent depends on context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang digunakan dalam nama orang dan sesetengah nama tempat; rujukannya bergantung pada konteks.
senses.nuances: 属专有名词，正常书写为 Lefferts。输入没有原句，不能确定指哪位人物或哪个地点。未确认其为 DBP 普通词条，因此不标注 official；马来文释义为本条编写。以下为示范组合，不代表经过频率统计的固定搭配。纽约市地标档案确认该姓氏见于 Lefferts Homestead 的历史记录。[纽约市地标档案](https://s-media.nyc.gov/agencies/lpc/lp/0152.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Lefferts appears in Brooklyn’s Dutch American history as a family name. New York City’s landmark record describes a farmhouse built for Peter Lefferts after the American Revolution and later moved to Prospect Park. This documents a historical bearer of the surname, but does not establish which person or place the isolated input denotes. [NYC landmark record](https://s-media.nyc.gov/agencies/lpc/lp/0152.pdf)
